lines.text: Your eyes can't see this remote's light. So why can your phone camera?
Remotes blink infrared, light just past the red end your eyes detect, in a quick code the TV reads.
Many camera sensors respond to that infrared, so the blinks show up on screen.
Remote not working? Aim it at the camera and press a button. No flicker? Try new batteries, or another camera.
